newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Kinnevik unit to list TV company.
newsitem.headline: Kinnevik unit to list TV company.

text.p: Swedish media group Kinnevik's subsidiary Modern Times Group (MTG) said on Friday it intended to list its television production company MTV Produktion AB on the Stockholm Stock Exchange in spring 1997.
"The board of television production company MTV Produktion AB has decided to investigate the possibility of a new share issue and widening of its ownership," MTG said in a statement.
"The intention is to apply for a listing in spring 1997 on the Stockholm Stock Exchange," it said.
MTV Produktion is the largest television production company in Scandinavia, MTG said.
MTV Produktion is currently owned by four individuals, it said.
